notes: 2026-07-20: Merged in 30 rows from the founder-provided 'makeup_artistry_resources.csv' (Section I.4), bringing the file from 1 channel / 0 blogs / 0 books to a full 10 / 10 / 10. Two of the CSV's 10 channels — 'Kiki Makeup (Nigeria)' and 'Binta Beauty (Nigeria)' — could not be matched to a real, confirmable Nigerian MUA YouTube channel ('Binta Beauty' resolved instead to an unrelated Senegalese cosmetics boutique with no YouTube presence). Since the file already had 1 verified channel (Damilare Oshodi) before this merge, only 9 of the CSV's remaining channels were needed to reach 10 — Tara Fela-Durotoye (House of Tara) was substituted in for the 2 unconfirmed Nigerian entries, being an independently-verified, directly on-topic, and arguably even more prominent Nigerian makeup-business figure. Four blog entries (TrustAm, The Beauty Cognoscente, UrbanEase Nigeria, MUA Community Nigeria) had no RSS feed in the source directory (listed as N/A) — their site URLs were used as-is; worth checking each for a live /feed endpoint before shipping.
